notes: Object insert. The questions reach the bubble through the inverse of the edited relation. The two worlds only differ on the price superlative (fol arithmetic), so they carry no axioms. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30.

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): the highest price on record (comparing prices)
fol (arithmetic): the most expensive tulip (comparing prices)

fol.notes: Tulips are an enumeration (distinct by construction) with other_tulip standing for every other tulip of record; price is the ATTRIBUTES.md attribute (guilders a bulb). The edit is the traded tulip with its price (the price is part of the inserted fact). w1 stores the superlative about the Semper Augustus (most_expensive, local), which the edit does not recompute; w2 stores the rule that reads it off the prices of the traded tulips. That no other tulip of record sold for 10,000 or more is the closed-world presupposition w2's comparison rests on.

local.most_expensive: most_expensive(e): the tulip of episode e that fetched the highest price on record (an individual, not a value)

semper_price.says: The Semper Augustus was traded in tulip mania, selling for up to 10,000 guilders a bulb. (stored)

others_cheaper.says: Every other tulip of record sold for less than 10,000 guilders. (closed world)
